name: Mittal Clothing
description:
Mittal Clothing is an app made to help field staff check the quality of clothes in different factories. Each user can see the factories assigned to them.

• Secure login to access assigned factories.
• Navigate to factory location using Google Maps.
• Inspect and record cloth quality on-site.
• Update personal details through an easy profile section.
• Punch-in and punch-out for attendance record.
• View assigned factories, inspection history, and performance.
summary: App designed to help field staff to inspect cloth quality.
